title: Quantization sensitivity probe and calibrated fallback runbook
creator: Claire Nguyen
description:
Context: We need a repeatable, low-latency pipeline that assesses model and config changes for quantized deployments (AWQ/GPTQ, int8/int4) and produces an actionable threshold and rollback decision. Current ad-hoc experiments show that some workloads tolerate AWQ-int4 with <1% utility loss while others degrade catastrophically; we lack per-route, cohort-aware gates that map signal -> automatic fallback.

Goal: Build a sensitivity probe and calibrated fallback runbook that: (1) computes per-route fidelity deltas for new quant profiles against canonical FP16 baselines, (2) synthesizes statistically robust delta thresholds tied to user-facing metrics and token-budget costs, and (3) integrates with Console alerts + rollout policies to auto-fallback when thresholds breach.

Scope & Acceptance criteria:
- Probe can run end-to-end in CI for a PR or as part of a canary rollout.
- Produces a JSON report with cohort-level metrics (semantic similarity, answer correctness rate, top-n overlap, KL divergence of token distributions, generation latency, cost delta).
- A threshold synthesis component recommends safe per-route thresholds and a confidence score; stable thresholds chosen for 95% CI on primary metrics.
- Automatic fallback trigger implemented as a policy that can be attached to a rollout; when violated, requests route to a higher-fidelity variant (e.g., int8->FP16 or AWQ->GPTQ) with minimal latency penalty.
- Integration tests: two synthetic cohorts + three customer-style cohorts run; no more than 2% end-user accuracy regression in high-impact routes when thresholds are enforced.

Datasets and metrics:
- Datasets: Summarization cohort (internal SummEval subset), Code-generation snippets (internal codebench), Retrieval QA prompts (50k synthetic + 5k human-labeled samples).
- Metrics: ROUGE-L, Exact Match, normalized semantic-embedding similarity (CosSim), likelihood-shift (mean delta logprob on reference completions), per-token latency and token-cost estimate.

Design notes and trade-offs:
- We prioritize semantic-similarity + correctness over raw token-F1 because quantization noise tends to alter phrasing while preserving intent.
- Use bootstrapped confidence intervals rather than parametric assumptions because metric distributions are heavy-tailed.
- Conservative default thresholds to avoid user-facing regressions; experiment with relaxed thresholds behind feature flags for low-cost routes.

Implementation plan:
1) Probe harness (week 1): small, containerized harness that spins model variants and computes metrics on specified cohorts.
2) Threshold synthesizer (week 1-2): statistical module that ingests multiple runs and outputs recommended thresholds with CI and suggested rollback budget.
3) Rollout policy + Console integration (week 2-3): wire into rollout wiring to detect threshold breaches and route traffic.
4) Smoke + Gate (week 3): automated canary job + dashboard and alerting playbook.

Operational runbook (high level):
- If the probe shows >5% EM drop or embedding cosine < 0.92 on high-impact cohort, auto-fallback to next-fidelity variant and create an incident channel tag.
- If metric delta between AWQ-int4 and GPTQ-int8 is within uncertainty, recommend cost-saving profile and mark for manual review.

Notes on reproducibility: all runs must log seed, tokenizer version, model hash, kernel config, and quant profile tags to the artifact report.

2025-02-14 - Amit Shah: Prototype harness checked in (github: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-experiments/pull/337). Harness currently supports AWQ-int4, GPTQ-int8 and FP16 baseline. Running first SummEval sweep now.

2025-02-16 - Amit Shah: Initial SummEval results: AWQ-int4 vs FP16 shows median ROUGE-L delta -1.9 pts, embedding cosine median 0.964; code-generation EM delta 3.4% on small sample. We observed a heavy tail: 2% of examples exceed 10% degradation — these map to long-context summarization (context > 2k tokens).

2025-02-18 - Claire Nguyen: Design review notes: prefer bootstrapped CIs for thresholds; request to add mean delta logprob and top-1 token KL as secondary signals. Also asked for per-batch latency histograms to estimate SLA impact.

2025-02-20 - Amit Shah: Threshold synthesizer v0 landed (github: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-experiments/pull/349). Synthesizer recommends per-route safety margin and outputs a JSON report. Hooked basic alerting to staging Console dashboard (dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/quant-sensitivity/ENG-998452). Next: add rollback policy and integrate with rollout API.
